events.text: Add auth to the API. Ask me what you need before you start.

questions.question: Which auth approach should the API use?

options.label: Session cookies
options.description: Server-side sessions; simplest for the web app, needs a store.

options.label: JWT
options.description: Stateless tokens; works for the mobile app too, harder to revoke.

options.label: OAuth only
options.description: Delegate sign-in to GitHub and Google; no passwords to store.
